{"bash_command":"git","full_command":"git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
test: add failing tests for unified plugin SDK core (23-1)

RED phase of TDD for Story 23-1. Creates 6-crate SDK structure with
todo!() stubs and 126 tests covering all 14 acceptance criteria:
- AC-1: Facade re-exports (7 tests)
- AC-2: AxiathonPlugin lifecycle trait (10 tests)
- AC-3: PluginManifest with 14 fields (11 tests)
- AC-4: PluginId namespace:name format (29 tests)
- AC-5: PluginKind 6 variants (9 tests in identity_tests)
- AC-6: PluginHealth 3 states (9 tests)
- AC-7: PluginError 8 variants (17 tests)
- AC-8: Config validation via jsonschema (5 tests in manifest_tests)
- AC-9: Ingestion traits (18 tests)
- AC-10: ProtocolDissector trait (7 tests)
- AC-11: NotificationChannel trait (8 tests)
- AC-12: ResponseAction trait (10 tests)
- AC-13: Object safety for all 7 traits (compile tests)

55 tests fail (RED) due to unimplemented stubs. 71 pass (structural
checks, serde round-trips on derived types, mock trait impls).

Also fixes pre-existing test quality issues in axiathon-core:
- Replace vacuous proptest with unused seeds (property_types.rs)
- Strengthen debug assertions to check field values, not just non-empty
- Fix weak OR assertion on NotFound display to assert both fields
- Add missing Validation variant check on too-long TenantId
- Replace tautological error propagation tests with real ? chains
EOF
)"","description":"Commit failing tests for SDK"}
